The range occupies the rear stem of the void,leaving the main front court and two smaller rear courts. Native28/29 are clipped parent fragments,not duplicate palaces. No copied sculpted reliefs,inscriptions,private photographs/textures,night lighting or full optical interiors. Physical device timings unmeasured.
